owned_invariants: It writes only the generated block between README_BEGIN and README_END of each WF6-WF49 README, and the family nodes of dag/reviews/workflows_audit.json; a README without exactly one pair of markers is refused.
With --check it writes nothing and lists every output whose bytes differ, then the drift report; the command exits 1 when that list is non-empty.
A rendered block that names a private project is refused with the field it came from.
A hosted family whose Rust source or test file is missing is refused.
A file whose first 4096 bytes contain CRLF is written back with CRLF.
boundaries: It never writes workflows/README.md or workflows/dag/workflow_dag.json; it only reports their drift.
It certifies nothing about a family; the host check does.

score.level_basis: A documentation generator with one job: render each family README block and audit record from the registry and refuse stale or private output. No verdict about a family is made here.

basis.G1: Module docstring states the outputs, the --check mode and the private-name guard; the contract names every top-level symbol. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond workflows/README.md.
basis.G2: No arithmetic. Outputs are compared byte for byte; JSON is written with a fixed indent and the existing line endings.
basis.G3: Missing markers, missing host files and private names raise ValueError with the family id and field. Not B: unreadable files raise the reader's own error.
basis.G4: 494 tests pass in the recorded run, 14 of them on this module (main, build with and without --check, stale detection, drift parsing, host-file refusal, CRLF window, guard message). Mutation campaign R = 78/78. Not B: one generated campaign, no property tests.
basis.G5: Measured worst cyclomatic 11, cognitive 14, nesting 2; ceiling B, recorded B.
